name: English SDH Preference
description: Opt-in English SDH subtitle preference; audio untouched.
overview: Opt-in English SDH subtitle preference; audio untouched.

versions.changelog: Recognize regional English subtitle tags; 18 new regression cases.
Initial opt-in English SDH preference release.

name: Max Quality
description: Plays every video at its original quality: a client's bitrate limit no longer forces a transcode. A quality you pick during playback is respected for the rest of that video.
overview: Direct play at original quality; your mid-playback quality choice is respected

versions.changelog: Fix: 1.0.0.0 failed to load on Jellyfin 12.1 (NullReferenceException in PluginManager.CreatePluginInstance) because the plugin class derived from the non-generic BasePlugin, whose Version is never set. It now derives from BasePlugin<PluginConfiguration>.

name: Simkl Mark Sync
description: Sends the movies and episodes you mark played or unplayed in Jellyfin to Simkl. Uses the Simkl login saved by the official Simkl plugin, which only sends what you play. A removal always names its episodes, so Simkl never deletes a whole show.
overview: Send manual played / unplayed marks to Simkl

versions.changelog: First release: manual played and unplayed marks of movies and episodes are sent to Simkl in batches, using the official Simkl plugin's login.
